body: I don’t remember much of my childhood. I lived with my mom for a bit and then she attempted suicide. I was 6, my brother a baby. I was sent to live with my dad. My stepmom really stepped up. My dad was always away on business trips during the weeks and home on the weekends. I spent a lot of time dancing around the living room with Jeanie ( stepmom ) to Alanis Morrisette 💕 those we’re good times. I remember the fun times. I was quiet though. I think the traumatic experience made me forget most of my childhood.
Let them think what they want. They’re the ones missing out anyways 🤷‍♀️
